name: Doodh Daftar
summary: Dairy farm register: herd with ear tags, milking entry, feed stock, vaccines and milk sales
about: A soft, friendly register for a small dairy farm with cows and buffaloes, in PKR. It keeps every animal with its tag, breed and stage, takes morning and evening milking in one quick list while a pail fills up, tracks feed stock and days left, lists vaccinations that are due and records milk supplied to shops with a running khata. A yield chart per animal and a herd heatmap show who is milking well.
how: The milk can on the Farm page fills to today's litres while drops fall in; switch the chart between 7D, 30D and 12M.
Open Milking, pick Morning or Evening and type litres per animal: the pail rises and splashes as the total grows.
On Herd, filter cows, buffaloes or dry animals and open any card for its vaccines and last two weeks of milk.
Yield lets you pick an animal for its own chart, with a heatmap and ranking for the whole herd.
Feed shows days left for each item; record a purchase or feed today's ration to update the store.
Milk sales keeps each shop's khata: record supply and payments and see who still owes.
